vision.name: Black Sacred Defense Drill
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 3.
(Limit 1 per deck. Use only if your opponent has performed a successful attack this combat.)
[Defense] POWER: Prevent all damage from an attack.
Discard a card from your hand. [Warning]: This attack deals no damage.
(Created by Daniel Behee, OP5 South Kai Champion)
